statement: The config layer (scripts/lib/config.py) reads a checkout's change store, .tower/config, as overrides of the registry's defaults. .tower/ is gitignored, but a forced add commits it and nothing refused that, and the pinned job's overlay neither restored nor removed it, so a pull request could ship an override that turns regime.exception_active back on (lifting every lock) or loosens any gate, budget or threshold key without touching a gate file; the threshold check compares registry defaults only and missed it. Found in the independent review of THREAT-gate, THREAT-config and THREAT-planning (tampering, elevation of privilege).
reason: Fixed 2026-11-19 in three layers (D-335): (1) the structure check's hygiene scan refuses any tracked file under the change store's directory (repo_hygiene.tower_store_errors, rule STD-repo-hygiene-tower-store-errors; test_repo_hygiene.TowerStore); (2) scripts/verify-commit names its checkout in $OU_CONFIG_REGISTRY_ONLY, which every stage and test it spawns inherits, and config.registry_only then reads registry defaults only for that checkout (test_config_api.GateMode, test_verify_commit.GateMode); (3) gate_pin.overlay deletes .tower/ from the pinned job's checkout (gate_pin.remove_store; test_gate_pin.Overlay.test_the_change_store_the_head_brings_is_deleted).
